sourceValue: a burst contributes to state standard-deviation features only when it contains at least 200 magnitudes

sourceTestArtifact.coverage: The released test uses 250 values; the fixture adds the untested 199/200 boundary without changing the disclosed predicate.

limitations: This binding begins after one source burst has been parsed and its magnitude vector has been constructed; it does not parse axes or infer missing values.
Magnitude calculation, Android/iOS scaling, standard deviation, time-category assignment, and cross-burst averaging remain separate dependencies.
The source count is an integer vector length; this fixture does not broaden the setting to fractional or nonfinite observations.
